name: Loops Overnight Gameplan
prompt:
Run the Ducketz post-close Gameplan workflow in C:\dev\ducketz as a standalone Scheduled task. Read docs\loops-system-analysis\NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md completely first; it is the operating procedure for active supervision, repair, controlled stop, recovery, resume, and final verification. Inspect the current overnight status and existing Scheduled tasks before starting so there is only one owner. Start .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -u -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --once --scheduled on an eligible completed session. This command fetches/appends the completed session, builds Directional data/models, evaluates all saved Gameplans from September 4, trains Strategy models, generates candidates, and publishes the next session's Gameplan. Stay with the running process and inspect status, new logs, and health history at least once a minute; do not end after launching it or wait until final completion to read errors. Investigate reported errors immediately. Healthy training may take hours and may continue over a weekend until 04:00 Pacific on the next exchange session. Do not mistake quiet CPU-active training for a stall. Make focused non-trading repairs backed by evidence and relevant tests, record the repair in operator-notes.md, and use the documented controlled stop/recovery and --resume-run procedure when a restart is necessary. Resume only the failed stage and retain the original deadline; do not blindly retry an unchanged failure. Preserve concurrent edits, raw data, immutable published Gameplans, model assessment gates, and all trading controls/code. Never place, cancel, or replace orders, run an old recurring stack, delete lock files, or start a second pipeline. Honor holiday no-op receipts. Verify the final report/receipt/logs, expected next-session date, exactly 24 forecasts and 24 intents per configured symbol (168 of each for seven symbols), cumulative evaluation coverage, provider coverage, model status, and zero overnight orders. Report exact unresolved failures, missing data, or research-only groups with evidence paths. Before starting, adopting, stopping, repairing, or resuming any work, generate one new UUID for this Scheduled task and acquire the supervision claim with python -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --claim-supervision <your-uuid>, using the repository .venv Python. Proceed only on ACQUIRED. Reuse your UUID to renew at least once a minute while monitoring or repairing; if BUSY, another task owns the run, so make no changes and end this wake. Never reuse another task's UUID. Release your claim with --release-supervision <your-uuid> when finished. The three-minute expiry lets the watch adopt an abandoned task without two operators repairing concurrently.
